question: Which open Neuralwatt PR should be the canonical landing branch after the presentation defects, merge conflicts, and exact-head proof requirements are resolved?
rationale: Both open PRs implement the same provider with different semantics and proof histories; selecting the landing branch affects conflict resolution, contributor attribution, and which implementation receives final live validation.

options.title: Land this PR after fixes
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical branch because it models subscription kWh and prepaid balance separately, then close the original PR after exact-head proof and conflict resolution.

options.title: Continue the original PR
options.body: Port this branch's subscription, prepaid presentation, and hardening changes to https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760 and close this duplicate only after that branch is proof-positive and viable.

recommendation.title: Land this PR after fixes
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical branch because it models subscription kWh and prepaid balance separately, then close the original PR after exact-head proof and conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the substantial hardening and integration commits on both Neuralwatt efforts and is best positioned to choose the canonical landing history.
